text: Binary flag from the OP's own voice in the supplied current title and argument (including marked edits): 1 if the OP states their view in affirmatively absolute or definitive declarations (categorical claims such as 'always', 'never', 'obviously', 'undeniably', 'there is no way', or unqualified certainty stated as fact); 0 if no such wording is present. Absence of tentative language alone is not enough; explicit absolute/definitive wording is required. Excludes quotations or reported opponents' positions unless the OP adopts them. Excludes view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred (generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not excluded). Does not reconstruct an initial snapshot. Returns null if both title and argument are missing or malformed.
